text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff... All right, that's ten laps.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aw c'mon, that was barely a warm-up. I
feel like I could do ten more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of the summer training
program, right when racers start to get
worn out. The blazing sun and white-hot
sand don't help
with the exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But I'm so close to breakin' my old
records.
If I don't push through,
How'm I s'posed to
forge my body into a racin' machine?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wanna go all out today!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Works for me! 'Kay, be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Tamamo Cross is feeling extra
motivated today. With that
in mind, I lead
her through an extra intense afternoon
training session.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah, there ya are! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna check out the nearby festival?
You're free right now,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Awesome. Actually, I was thinkin' I'd give
that whole treatin' yaself
thing another try.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I worked my butt off today, didn't
I? That regimen of yours
was enough for
two days... So you know...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I mean, if you say so, then that
settles it. I'm treatin' myself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna walk around and stuff my face with
festival food! I've wanted to do that ever
since I was a kid!
Those stalls better watch out, 'cause
here I come!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hmmm what to get... It all looks so good!

text_block_list.name: Festival Man
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate bananas! Get your chocolate
bananas here! Special deal!
Win a game of
rock, paper, scissors and get a second one
for free!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate bananas! That sounds pretty
good, but maybe I should get
somethin'
with more substance...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right, but... shouldn't I spend my money
more... wisely?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, you suck at rock, paper,
scissors,
huh? All right, leave it to
me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll take one chocolate banana, please!

text_block_list.name: Festival Man
text_block_list.text:
Comin' right up! But before that... rock,
paper...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Scissors!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I won! I got you two chocolate bananas,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... Guess that's only fair...
Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whoa! Lookit, they've got doteyaki!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
White miso paste?! No way, most joints in
and around Tokyo use the
mixed stuff or
soy sauce... We gotta eat here!

text_block_list.name: Festival Woman
text_block_list.text:
Dis girl gets it!
Dis here's the real deal!
How'd ya like a little snack,
kiddo?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, my dad's always eatin' stuff like
this... Hey, wait, who're ya
callin' kiddo?!

text_block_list.name: Festival Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I thought ya were in elementary
school. My bad, my bad. How
'bout a bowl
on da house?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What? Really?! Ah, then how 'bout ya
gimme two, and I'll pay ya half
price?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... These beef tendons meltin' in my
mouth... The subtle
sweetness of the miso
paste... I'm in paradise!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now this is a worthwhile purchase! Two doteyaki for the price of one! Feels like I'm back home!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha,
nice choice! If I'm vouchin' for this
place's authenticity, ya
know it's good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Next up is... takoyaki! You want some?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Then let's split one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After receiving our order of takoyaki, we
both dig in.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Where's the octopus? This takoyaki's all
dough.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess you weren't expectin' much
either, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I never got it before. Why would
people buy takoyaki at
festivals when legit
takoyaki joints are much better?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I think I get it now. It's the atmosphere,
right? It adds this extra flavor
you can't
get anywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right? But ya know,
if I hadn't tried these
takoyaki, I woulda kept on
wonderin' that
for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Guess the same goes for treatin' myself
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's the point of these little treats,
right? Sometimes you need a
little break if
you wanna go even higher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross looks up to the sky as she
continues.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya know what I thought after eatin'
pancakes with ya? "I wanna eat
'em again."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pancake mix's always been enough for me,
but now? It's like that
cafe's pancakes are
a goal for me to reach.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But I gotta work hard if I wanna eat 'em,
right? So this whole treatin'
myself
business works as motivation too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All I wanted was to see her reward herself
more often, but it seems
she's taken it as a
way to improve herself. That's Tamamo
Cross for you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And ya know what? Now I know 'bout all
sorts of tasty things! Things I
can show my
family!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Maybe next time... I'll be able to actually buy my parents an anniversary gift myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back to the day we went shopping.
Tamamo Cross was so overwhelmed by the
prices that she actually ran away, so I
picked
something out for her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Which is why I gotta keep givin'
myself treats every once in a
while. I'll be
countin' on your help, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but no expensive chocolates, please.
Just walkin' 'round and
eatin' street food is
luxurious enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Of course I didn't! Ya think dis proud Naniwa racer would ever pay askin' price for somethin'?! I'm not touchin' it unless I know it's a steal!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You got that right!
And that pride is what's
gonna take me to the top,
with pit stops
for treats along the way!
